2nd Danang trip this year
Sep 2026 • Family
We had a delicious meal at this Vietnamese restaurant.
The phở bò was fragrant and comforting, with a rich, flavourful broth, tender beef, and perfectly cooked rice noodles. The bánh xèo was crispy on the outside, generously filled, and especially enjoyable with the fresh herbs and dipping sauce.
The garlic stir-fried morning glory was fresh, crunchy, and full of savoury garlic flavour without being too oily.
The crab fried rice was another highlight, with fragrant rice, a satisfying wok-fried taste, and generous pieces of crab throughout.
Overall, everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and served in generous portions. It was a wonderful introduction to Vietnamese cuisine, and I would happily Return
